description: The scripts under scripts/ that change or probe production; a cloud session never runs them and a PR diff never adds an invocation of them. Empty: OU-DECOUPLE F4 (D-111) took Open University's production entrypoints (ship-tail, neon-migrate, ship-verify, merge-phase, preview-deploy, production-check, neon-pr) out of the repository and the engine has no production deploy; an entrypoint that comes back is named here.
